paragraphs: Avimi bar Nazi, father-in-law of Ravina (read: of Ravinai). [Bava Kamma 115a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.115a.22).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Gemara and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=153&lang=en) give Ravina as Avimi bar Nazi’s father-in-law. Ravinai is Hyman’s proposed reading.
The Gemara describes Avimi’s loan and a stolen cloak brought in repayment, before the case comes to Ravina.
